description: Illustrate a monthly note the way the finance page does. Pass price, down, aprPercent, and months. Returns the principal, the formula payment, and the rounded dollars the page shows. Arithmetic only. Not a credit offer, not a rate lock, and not a promise a lender will take the deal. Taxes, freight, a battery, and a doc fee are not included. This desk does not publish a rate. The page allows a price from 5000 to 80000, a down payment from 0 through the price, an APR from 0 to 24, and a term of 24, 36, 48, or 60 months. The page opens on 16500, 2000 down, 11 percent, and 36 months as an illustration, not a quoted rate.

aprPercent.description: Illustrated APR. The finance page runs from 0 to 24. Not a rate from this desk. Opening illustration: 11.

down.description: Down payment in USD. The finance page allows 0 through the truck price. Opening illustration: 2000.

months.description: Term in months. The finance page offers 24, 36, 48, or 60. Opening illustration: 36.

price.description: Truck price in USD. The finance page runs from 5000 to 80000. Opening illustration: 16500.
